children: Quarterhill received a roughly $28.2 million contract for work on Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority's new ExpressLanes Back Office System, one of America's largest managed lane back-office modernization programs.
The Canadian company said it has been selected as a subcontractor to BRiC-TPS to support Metro ExpressLanes operations and maintenance on interstate freeways I-10, I-110, I-105, and future corridors.
The subcontract includes an eight-year base term and two three-year option periods for up to 14 years.

The program encompasses core tolling operations, customer account and transaction management, financial and operational reporting, system integrations, and ongoing maintenance and support services. Quarterhill said it would contribute project management and documentation support, security compliance oversight, and on-site customer service center help-desk personnel.
